messages:
Maya: Quick thread / need a tight SDR one-pager + 3 battlecard zingers for next week's launch. Keep it snackable. :taco:

Ethan: I'll draft the zingers: economics, deployment parity, graceful degradation. 15 words max each.

Priya: One-pager plan: 2-line opener, 3 pain/rebut bullets, 2 qualifier Qs, routing hint. Will send draft by 3pm.

Ops: We can tag inbound leads by intent. Send patterns and target queues.

Ethan: Routing prototype:
```
- pattern: ".*benchmark|latency|p95|throughput"
  queue: sdr-bench
- pattern: ".*SLA|enterprise|private deployment|VPC|dedicated"
  queue: ae-enterprise
- pattern: ".*on-prem|air-gapped|HSM|compliance"
  queue: solutions
```

bench-bot: new benchmark (2026-05-10) summary: "~18% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools; throughput +1.3x at 4k context with batching." Methodology: link. Add one-line caveat on all external claims.

Maya: Nice. Make sure the SDR one-pager includes the legal caveat exactly: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; see methodology." Review at 15:30. Thanks :sparkles:
